title: Lunar Prospector - Pixon Reconstructed Maps (Wilson et al., 2018)
description: Improved-resolution maps of Lunar Prospector Neutron Spectrometer (NS) and Gamma Ray Spectrometer (GRS) data produced via global application of pixon image reconstruction techniques (Wilson et al., 2018, JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2018JE005589). Datasets cover epithermal neutrons (primary H/water-ice proxy), the Sn-covered sensor blended thermal+epithermal signal, and Th-line GRS count rates. All maps form a 1024×512 equal-angle rectangular grid covering the full lunar surface. Source data: LP-NS and LP-GRS PDS archives. Authors: J. T. Wilson, D. J. Lawrence, P. N. Peplowski, J. T. S. Cahill, V. R. Eke, R. J. Massey, L. F. A. Teodoro.
